title: Substitution for Member at Magway Region Investment Committee
text:
The Republic of the Union of Myanmar
Myanmar Investment Commission
Notification No. 24/ 2021
nd
2 Waning of Pyatho 1382 ME
(29 January 2021)
Substitution for Member at Magway Region Investment Committee
Daw Ohmmar Myint, Director of the Environmental Conservation Department has
been appointed as the member of Magway Region Investment Committee which was
formed by the Notification No. 57/ 2017 of the Myanmar Investment Commission.
(Thaung Tun)
Chairman
